units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:6">Bets. III, 6</cite> <he>אין מַשְׁגִּיחִין בכף וכ׳</he> you must not look at the scales at all, i.e. on the Holy Day you dare not use the scales at all, even if you employ some substitute for weights; Y. ib. 62ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:5">Tosef. ib. III, 5</cite>.
Ber. 52ᵃ אין משגיחין בבת קול we do not consider a voice from on high, i.e. we are not guided in our decisions by a bath ḳol (v. בַּת I); a. e.

senses.gloss: (with על) to look for, care for, mind. Y. Keth. VIII, 3ᵇ bot. ואין ברייה מַשְׁגַּחַת עליה and nobody will care for her (to assist her in her bereavement).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 34b:28">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>לא היו מַשְׁגִּיחִים עליו</he> they would have paid no attention to his prayers.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99a:20">Snh. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מי שאינו מַשְׁגִּיחַ על המשנה</he> he who disregards the Mishnah; a. fr.
